image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is positioned centrally among wet, decaying brown autumn leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible with small dark eyes, and the body is robust. Short limbs are partially visible, tucked under the body or obscured by leaves. The tail extends towards the right, appearing laterally compressed. The background consists of out-of-focus leaf litter and possibly damp soil or rock.
